title: Injection context
description: Learn what an injection context is in Angular and when you can call the inject() function.

blocks.text: The inject() function in Angular requires an active injection context. An injection context is available during specific phases of an application's lifecycle, such as construction of components, directives, and services, or field initializers.
When is an injection context available?

items: In property initializers (field declarations) of a class decorated with @Injectable(), @Component(), or @Directive().
In factory functions provided to useFactory or functional route guards / resolvers.
